rationale: Weekly profile mandates fresh X-native Grok Source Intake before Discovery acceptance. No W39 result is reused; W40 uses the fixed September 25 to October 2 New York EDT window. Independent A-L and open-world search precede W39 carry-over rechecks.

runs.purpose: Fresh W40 X-native signal and independent open-world search
research_questions: What technically material X-native developments appeared in the ordinary W40 window?
What did independent maintainers/evaluators reproduce, integrate or falsify?
Which primary artifacts must be verified by ChatGPT before inclusion?
What W39 HOLD or post-cutoff observations deserve explicit W40 recheck?
